bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'PR47_WORKTREES\n'
git worktree list --porcelain | grep -E '^(worktree|branch|HEAD) ' | sed -n '1,60p'
printf 'PR47_DEPLOY_SCRIPTS\n'
find deploy scripts -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*deploy*' -o -iname '*build*' \) 2>/dev/null | head -20
printf 'PR47_COMPOSE_LABELS\n'
docker inspect --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir" }}|{{ index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files" }}|{{.Config.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1

{ printf 'PR47_WORKTREE_AND_DEPLOY_READBACK\n'; git worktree list --porcelain | grep -E '^(worktree|branch|HEAD) ' | head -45; printf 'DEPLOY_FILES\n'; find deploy scripts -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*deploy*' -o -iname '*build*' \) 2>/dev/null | head -20; printf 'COMPOSE_IMAGE\n'; docker inspect --format '{{.Config.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
